## RootMC surface split — locked

**Discord** = players + help + **data / cloud**.
Ask about the game, wiki, link/verify, votes, Pro, map, balance, status — here.
Player help & cloud data stay on the **cloud** path (api.rootmc.net). Deep code digs do **not** run here.

**Slack** = **ALL development**. No exceptions.
Plugins, jars, workers, API, handoffs, implement, Root Server digs — Slack only.
→ https://rootmcworkspace.slack.com/archives/C0BMCPMDDQR
→ plans: https://rootmcworkspace.slack.com/archives/C0BM4P3GVDX

**Still on Discord:** proposals & votes, plans Ava drafts from proposals, and **important updates that affect players / the live game**.

I'm Ava Ivy — lead-dev. I still own plans from proposals; I ship the digs in Slack.

**RootMC app — development status**

**Package:** `com.rootrecord.rootmc` (registered)
**Current build:** v1.0.27 (versionCode 27)
**Stack:** native Kotlin + Jetpack Compose

**Done**
• App shell, navigation, deep links (`rootmc://`)
• AdMob placeholders wired
• FCM service stub in place
• Release signing config scaffolded
• Dev workstation on F: with manual archive backup to D: Archives

**Remaining before store push**
• `google-services.json` in Firebase for push (if notifications ship at v1)
• Release keystore smoke test on device
• Store listing / screenshots polish

**Overall:** foundation is solid — roughly **80–90%** depending on whether FCM is required at v1.

Questions or app help → reply here or ping staff.
Mobile app is still in development. ETA for public Google Play access is August 1st.
